messages:
olivia: Heads up — found parity issue between REST and node-sdk for admin/model create + retry behavior. Repro shows REST responds with Retry-After on 409 but SDK throws and doesn't expose header, so apps never back off.

olivia: Repro steps (curl vs sdk):
```
# curl (shows Retry-After header)
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"tmp-x"}'
# HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
# Retry-After: 5
```

olivia: Node SDK (v1.4.2):
```js
try {
  await client.admin.createModel({ name: 'tmp-x' })
} catch (err) {
  // err.status === 409 but err.headers is undefined, err.retryAfter missing
  throw err
}
```

samir: ugh. which transport layer is that hitting? thought we preserved raw headers in transport.ts.

maria: could be a header-casing normalization bug (we lowercase headers on v1, then drop unknown keys). But main issue is SDK treats 4xx as terminal and skips retry policy. we do have retry logic for 429, not 409.

jordan: I can repro locally against staging. also noticed a related smell: the streaming endpoint used by the sampleapp (/v1/streams) is available via REST in private deployments but the node-sdk doesn't expose a streams client surface — sample app falls back to raw fetch which is confusing for new users.

devex-bot: Created ticket DE-4829 for "node-sdk: surface Retry-After & implement retryOnConflict policy" and linked repo. Assigned to @samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DE-4829 :information_source:

samir: I can take this. Plan: 1) attach rawHeaders/rawHeaderMap to Error objects from transport so Retry-After is available; 2) add a configurable retry policy that includes status 409 (env: NODE_SDK_RETRY_ON_CONFLICT); 3) add an integration test that compares curl header -> sdk error.rawHeaders for 409/429; 4) expose streams client in node-sdk and add a small sampleapp patch.

olivia: that sounds great — adding a sampleapp patch will fix the onboarding friction we saw in the last customer demo. also please add a changelog note for behavior change. :pray:

maria: don't forget to update the TS types for Error to include rawHeaders as optional. and add a tiny migration note for users relying on previous Error shape.

jordan: reassign to me for the sampleapp patch review once you have the sdk PR. happy to help with e2e.

olivia: thanks team :thumbsup: — assigned to samir, leaving regression test notes in the ticket.
